candidate.answerReason: The shaded region contains three complete central triangles and half of a fourth. Each complete central triangle is one eighth of the octagon, so the shaded fraction is 3/8+1/16=7/16.

methods.label: Divide into equal triangles
methods.explanation:
Join \(O\) to all eight vertices. The regular octagon is divided into eight congruent triangles, so each has \(\frac18\) of the octagon's area.

The shaded region consists of triangles \(OBC\), \(OCD\), and \(ODE\), together with triangle \(OBX\). Since \(X\) is the midpoint of \(AB\), triangles \(OBX\) and \(OAX\) have equal bases and share the same height from \(O\). Thus \(OBX\) has half the area of \(OAB\), or \(\frac1{16}\) of the octagon's area.

These pieces cover the shaded region without overlapping interiors. Its fraction of the octagon is therefore
\[
\frac38+\frac1{16}
=\frac6{16}+\frac1{16}
=\boxed{\frac7{16}},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
